model.name: MiniMax H3 FL2VA Pruned PDD 8-Step 20B
model.description: Uses the smaller pruned model to generate synchronized video and audio from text and optional first/last frames. Each PDD step merges four learned denoising-interval outputs, covering 32 intervals in only 8 model evaluations.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] A five-second cinematic single take inside a rain-lashed glass observatory at midnight. A radio astronomer presses an antique transmitter and says clearly (S1) <d>[English] If you can hear me, follow this signal.</d> One brilliant blue pulse races across a translucent star map as the camera slowly pushes closer.
overall_soundscape: Rain on glass, a low electrical hum, three receiver tones, the synchronized voice, and a short stereo transmission pulse.
